Item: The Sarva-darśana- samgraha; or, Review of the different systems of Hindu philosophy · Madhava, Son of Sayana, Madhava, son of Mayana, called Vidyaranya, d. 1386, supposed author, Cowell, Edward Byles, 1826-1903, Gough, Archibald Edward, 1845- · 1914, 308 scanned pages. First published 1882, this printing 1914; Edward B. Cowell died 1903 and Archibald Edward Gough was born in 1845; Mādhava is medieval; public domain in India.
